_comment: Descriptions for the Contoso Bikes model of Power BI episode 1. Copilot reads only the first 200 characters of each, so the meaning comes first.

measures.Sales[Sales Amount]: Sales revenue before cost: quantity times unit price, summed over order lines. The default meaning of 'sales' and 'revenue'. Filters by order date.
measures.Sales[Total Cost]: Cost of the goods sold: quantity times unit cost, summed over order lines.
measures.Sales[Margin]: Gross margin amount: [Sales Amount] minus [Total Cost]. Use for 'margin' and 'profit'.
measures.Sales[Margin %]: Gross margin as a share of sales: [Margin] divided by [Sales Amount]. Never average line-level percentages.
measures.Sales[Units]: Number of units sold: the sum of the line quantity.
measures.Sales[Orders]: Number of distinct orders (order numbers), not order lines. Counted by order date. For orders by shipping date use [Orders Shipped].

columns.Customer[Country]: Country where the customer lives. For where the sale was made use Store[Country].
columns.Store[Country]: Country of the selling store. For where the customer lives use Customer[Country].

Sales.name: Orders Shipped
Sales.description: Number of distinct orders counted by ship date instead of order date, through the inactive Ship Date relationship. Use when the question says shipped or delivered.
